caption:
Celebrating 3 years as a Personal Trainer! 💪🏾🙏🏾

It’s crazy to think that three years ago, while sitting in a detox center, becoming a personal trainer wasn’t even on my mind. I had no idea where life was taking me or what God had planned for me.

title: The longer I’ve been bodybuilding, the more I’ve realized that bodybuilding doesn’t always need to be complicated.
hook: The longer I’ve been bodybuilding, the more I’ve realized that bodybuilding doesn’t always need to be complicated.
caption:
The longer I’ve been bodybuilding, the more I’ve realized that bodybuilding doesn’t always need to be complicated.

There’s value in understanding training volume, nutrition, recovery, exercise selection, and all the smaller details that can improve your results.

But sometimes the basic is still incredibly simple:

Eat enough food to grow.
Train hard.
Keep body fat under control.
Stay consistent long enough to build muscle.

Years of experience have taught me how to understand variables and nuances, but they’ve also reminded me that the basics were doing most of the heavy lifting all along.

caption:

Good calls get remembered as good. Awkward moments get smoothed over. The part where the buyer hesitated disappears entirely.

So you coach the story rather than the call, and nothing changes.

Read one transcript this week before your next sales meeting. It will change what the meeting is about.

title: Heavy rep sets and high rep sets have different demands.
hook: Heavy rep sets and high rep sets have different demands.
caption:
Heavy rep sets and high rep sets have different demands.
With heavier weights, the fight can start before the set does.
Can I lift it? What happens if I fail?
With higher reps, the weight feels manageable — until the burn builds, every rep gets harder, and stopping starts to sound very tempting.
Neither is inherently better. They’re different challenges.
Get used to both.
Let fear become familiar.
Let discomfort become familiar.
Make them your training partners.
Work with them until their presence becomes boring.
#BoringBasement #StrengthTraining #HypertrophyTraining #ProgressiveOverload #Home
